en.headline: Hong Kong expects 1.29 million mainland visitors over National Day week
en.dek: The Immigration Department forecasts more than a 5 percent rise in daily arrivals from 1 to 7 October, with 1,180 tour groups also expected, officials said after a coordination meeting.
body: Hong Kong expects about 1.29 million mainland visitors to enter through sea, land and air control points during the National Day Golden Week from 1 to 7 October, the Immigration Department estimated, with average daily arrivals more than 5 percent higher than last year’s corresponding period.

Chief Secretary Eric Chan Kwok-ki chaired an interdepartmental festive arrangements meeting on Wednesday to coordinate reception plans. Deputy Chief Secretary Cheuk Wing-hing, Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung and Under Secretary for Transport and Logistics Liu Chun-san also attended.

The Travel Industry Authority and the trade estimate 1,180 inbound tour groups over the same period. The authority has asked agents to stagger arrival times and work with attractions on crowd and coach management. Control-point departments will cut frontline leave, open extra counters and lanes, and operate a joint command centre from 1 to 7 October.

The MTR Corporation will strengthen services on several lines from 30 September to 7 October. The Transport Department said Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge and Lok Ma Chau–Huanggang shuttle buses will run as frequently as about one and two minutes apart at peak times, with extra cross-boundary coach quotas. Police will impose traffic controls around High Island Reservoir East Dam and Ham Tin Wan in Sai Kung at busy periods, and the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department will continue a trial real-name booking system for the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail.

zh.headline: 入境處料國慶黃金周約129萬內地旅客訪港
zh.dek: 當局預計10月1日至7日每日平均訪港人次較去年同期升逾5%，另有約1180個旅行團入境，政務司司長已主持跨部門會議統籌接待。
body: 入境事務處預計，內地國慶黃金周（10月1日至7日）期間約有129萬內地旅客經海、陸、空管制站進入香港，每日平均訪港人次較去年同期增加超過5%。
政務司司長陳國基周三主持節慶安排跨部門工作小組會議，統籌各部門接待工作。政務司副司長卓永興、保安局局長鄧炳強及運輸及物流局副局長廖振新等亦有出席。
旅遊業監管局及業界估計同期約有1180個旅行團入境。旅監局已提醒接待代理商盡量分散入境時間，並與景點協調分流及旅遊巴管理。口岸部門將減少前線人員休假、加開檢查櫃枱及通道，並於10月1日至7日啓動跨部門聯合指揮中心。
港鐵將於9月30日至10月7日加強多條絲路服務。運輸署表示，港珠澳大橋及落馬洲至皇崗穿梭巴士在高峰時段最密可分別約一分鐘及兩分鐘一班，並已增發跨境直通巴士配額。警方會在西貢萬宜水庫東壩及鹹田灣等熱點實施交通管制，漁農自然護理署亦會繼續在萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行實名預約。
